decisions.reason: A safety shoe line sits squarely in the firm's core in-house manufacturing and development know-how, so it can easily read early market feedback and refine the models.
The comfort insole complements the core footwear and draws on the firm's foot-measurement expertise, though as a simple accessory it is more easily replaced by newer variants.
The supportive insole builds on the firm's existing ergonomic and foot-measurement knowledge, but its overlap with the other insoles makes some consolidation possible.
The ergonomic series has a dedicated page and combines core shoe competence with the firm's ergonomics development, giving it strong absorptive capacity to improve it.
Firefighter boots are a specialised extension of protective footwear that the firm's materials and certification knowledge can support, though the niche demands distinct know-how.
The moulded insole is the firm's flagship on the home page and links its measurement tools, training services and footwear knowledge, so it is strategically central.
